dispositions.reason: Restores the source’s Chinese phonetic line so the language barrier remains meaningful until the Universal Language Pack is applied.
五臺山 is Mount Wutai in Shanxi; both current Mount Odae references identify the wrong geographic setting.
Restores the source’s literal cold wind and removes the unsupported silence image.
Formats the second goblin reaction as Taekyung’s internal thought rather than invented spoken dialogue.
Restores the established glossary term One Strike for 일격 in the System notification.
Corrects the direction of gratitude so the traveler is the person appreciated by the coachman.
Renders 본가 from Hyuk Mujin’s perspective as the family he and Taekyung belong to, not as an impersonal main branch.
Renders 맷집 as general toughness and punishment tolerance rather than resistance specifically associated with the chin.
Restores 큰형 as eldest brother, preserving the explicit sibling hierarchy.
Uses pavilion for the unnamed residential 전각 and keeps the term consistent across its later references in the chapter.
Replaces explicit anatomical profanity with the source-appropriate euphemistic glossary term Well-Endowed Man.
